course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice using även om to add a simple contrast to an opinion or plan.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A relaxed chat about weekend plans, weather, or whether an activity is worth doing.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Balancing a positive or negative point with a contrasting detail.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a plan that still sounds possible despite one small drawback.

main_focus.name: concession with även om
main_focus.description: Use även om to say that one fact does not stop the main idea.
model_examples: Jag vill gå ut även om det regnar lite.
Det låter kul även om jag är trött.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use även om naturally 2 times in the dialogue.

avoid_grammar: multiple contrast clauses in one sentence

useful_chunks: Det beror på hur sent det blir.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use contrast words in practical planning language, with no abstract debate.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker suggests or reacts to a simple plan.
dialogue_shape.middle: They mention one drawback and use även om to keep the plan possible.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide whether the plan is still worth doing.

target_complexity.repetition: include two clear examples of the concession pattern

focus: the drawback that could affect the plan
whether the plan remains possible and why

sentence_focus: one sentence with även om and weather
one sentence with även om and tiredness
one sentence saying a plan is still worth it
one sentence combining a drawback and a decision
